t: The two moments a fasting person gets
a: لِلصَّائِمِ فَرْحَتَانِ فَرْحَةٌ عِنْدَ فِطْرِهِ وَفَرْحَةٌ عِنْدَ لِقَاءِ رَبِّهِ
p: Li-ṣ-ṣāʾimi farḥatān: farḥatun ʿinda fiṭrih, wa farḥatun ʿinda liqāʾi rabbih
m: The fasting person has two joys: a joy when he breaks his fast, and a joy when he meets his Lord.
